title: Privileged path hardening: threat model and pen-test remediation for RBAC v2, audit, and SSO
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: After the latest third-party penetration test (Feb 2026) and an internal tabletop review, we identified multiple privileged-path issues spanning the RBAC v2 rollouts, SAML session handling, and audit logging semantics for admin events. This ticket codifies the threat model, groups pen-test findings by root cause, and tracks remedial engineering work needed to bring scoped admin pathways to a least-privilege, auditable, and testable state.

Scope: RBAC v2 enforcement for API routes with admin scope, Console admin UI flows, SAML assertion validation and replay resistance, audit log enrichment for admin actions (caller, session_id, request_fingerprint), and break-glass/one-time-admin token flows. Out of scope: Dedicated runtime GPU sidecars (tracked in security-infra-hardware).
threat_model_summary: Primary threats: (1) excessive inherited privileges from coarse role mappings in RBAC v2 leading to privilege escalation; (2) stale or unsigned SAML assertions enabling session replay; (3) missing correlation IDs in audit logs preventing post-incident reconstruction; (4) admin API endpoints lacking secondary checks allowing token misuse. Mitigations considered: role-narrowing + attribute-based checks, SAML assertion signature and audience strictness, mandatory session binding in audit records, and short-lived break-glass tokens with enforced MFA and manual justification records.
pen_test_findings: PT-2026-07: RBAC wildcard mapping allowed read-write on /admin/features when tenant role included 'write:*' rule. Repro steps + proof attached in penetration report. Recommended: disallow wildcard inheritance on admin-prefixed routes and require explicit allow entries.

PT-2026-09: SAML Assertion replay under 5-minute window due to missing nonce binding on the SP side. Repro: captured assertion replayed to create session. Recommended: implement nonce + audience + not-before strict checks and reject replays in SAML consumer.

PT-2026-12: Audit events for admin role changes lacked request_fingerprint and originating_session_id making rollback forensic analysis hard. Recommended: enrich audit schema and backfill for last 90 days where possible.
PT-2026-14: Break-glass flow allowed reuse of one-time tokens if concurrent session cookies present. Recommended: single-use cryptographic tokens, token-rotation, and server-side consumption record.

PT-2026-18: API tokens scoped to 'admin:*' were not subject to IP allowlist controls in Private deployments. Recommended: enforce IP and VPC-bound constraints for admin tokens and surface warnings in Console when creating such tokens.
remediation_plan: 1) RBAC v2 policy hardening: introduce admin-only role namespace and block wildcard inheritance for any role that maps to admin:* routes. Owner: @marcus-liu. GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4182

2) SAML consumer fixes: add nonce caching with 10-minute TTL, verify AudienceRestriction and NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter semantics, and add parser-level assertion size limits. Owner: @aisha-patel. GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/1297

3) Audit schema changes: add fields (request_fingerprint, originating_session_id, actor_auth_method, justification_id) and a migration to backfill last 90 days where logs exist. Owner: @sylvia-moreno. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Admin+Audit+Schema

4) Break-glass flow redesign: issue single-use signed token stored server-side (consumed=true) and require interactive MFA + free-text justification stored with audit. Owner: @devin-choi. Design note: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-breakglass
5) Token constraints for Private deployments: add VPC/IP constraints UI and server-side enforcement. Owner: @maria-gonzalez. Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2140

6) Test harness & e2e: add pen-test regression suite that replays key findings against staging with injected faults. Owner: @tests-team (coordinated by assignee). Test plan link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-tests/tree/main/pen-test-regressions
acceptance_criteria: RBAC admin namespace implemented and all admin-prefixed routes deny requests from roles containing wildcard inheritances (automated unit tests + integration test coverage)
SAML consumer rejects replayed assertions in staging (replay test passes) and asserts audience + time windows reliably
Audit events for admin actions include request_fingerprint and session_id; retention policy updated and migration validated
Break-glass tokens are single-use, require MFA, and are surfaced in admin audit logs with justification entries
Private deployment admin tokens can be created only with explicit VPC/IP constraints and console UI warns on unconstrained admin tokens
All code changes have security review sign-off and corresponding pen-test regression tests added to nightly pipeline
work_log: 2026-02-11: Kickoff meeting with SecOps, Auth, Runtime, and Console. Aligned on prioritized pen-test items and owners.
2026-02-16: Threat modeling session -- enumerated three admin pathways: Console UI, API tokens, and SSO session exchange. Decided to treat Console UI + API tokens as highest risk.
2026-02-20: Auth team prototype for nonce cache (in-memory + Redis fallback). Initial PR created.
2026-02-28: RBAC policy change proposal reviewed by Platform architects; requested additional integration tests to cover legacy role imports.
2026-03-05: Pen-test vendor validated our proposed SAML nonce approach in a focused retest; still failing on assertion size limits—added limit to parser.
2026-03-09: Migration plan for audit schema drafted; ops estimated 2 hours downtime for high-throughput index rebuild in staging only. Follow-up: schedule blackout window with SRE.
test_plan: Unit tests for RBAC mapping logic covering explicit deny/wildcard cases
SAML replay regression: capture a valid assertion and attempt replay within staging; expect 403 and audit record with reason=assertion_replay
Audit migration verification: cross-check event counts pre/post migration and sample queries for session correlation
Break-glass e2e: request token, consume token twice (second should fail), verify MFA prompt and audit justification
related_artifacts: Console PR for admin token constraints: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2140
blocking_issues: SRE scheduling for audit index migration (need outage window)
Legacy role import paths require compatibility shim before RBAC strict reject is enabled
Legal review for storing free-text justifications (PII concerns)
next_steps: Ship RBAC platform PR to staging behind feature flag and run integration tests (target merge: 2026-03-15)
Complete SAML parser hardening and add size limits (target merge: 2026-03-12)
Schedule audit migration during 2026-03-17 maintenance window with SRE and SecOps
Coordinate pen-test vendor for final validation once staging changes are deployed
